items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: He came down to the Woodside Hotel... said I'd like to audition for the group... And he worked out.

ctx.x: I'm going to show you some pictures of Artis, excellent pictures of Artis (inaudible).
I'm trying to think of another brass man that came through. Some of the things we're talking about now is passed that area but do you remember Chief--Russell Moore?
